statement: instrument_type is derived (instrument_classification._sql_classify_instrument_type, around line 1058-1366) before row corrections are applied (_apply_row_corrections, line 1532), and is not re-derived, so a corrected instrument_description leaves a stale instrument_type. Proposed: re-run the instrument_type (and lien) classification on rows whose corrected_fields include instrument_description, with a test (a revolver row corrected from 'Term Loan' gets instrument_type 'Revolver'; an uncorrected row keeps its type). Classified verification_bug for want of a better class: no check is weakened and nothing changes what counts as a finding; it is a shared ordering defect that publishes a value inconsistent with the corrected, page-backed instrument.
